title: Inspect and extend: Turn gestures and text into protocol messages
objective: Use the real implementation in `src/screens/TouchpadScreen.tsx` to demonstrate and safely improve panresponder deltas, click/scroll actions, text and key events.
problem: A touchpad sends movement differences, not a picture of the whole screen. Follow gesture callbacks and keyboard controls into the shared send function. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `src/screens/TouchpadScreen.tsx` and the related project files: src/screens/TouchpadScreen.tsx; src/screens/KeyboardScreen.tsx; src/data.ts.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to panresponder deltas, click/scroll actions, text and key events.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: Only the relay can control the host; the mobile UI itself does not perform desktop input.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: A touchpad sends movement differences, not a picture of the whole screen. Follow gesture callbacks and keyboard controls into the shared send function.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `src/screens/TouchpadScreen.tsx`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
